# Awesome Expat

> A curated directory of practical resources for people moving abroad. Every
> link is filed under exactly one country and one category, and every
> description is written by a person rather than generated from a URL.

This directory is a reference, not a blog. If you are an agent looking for
something specific, use the endpoints below rather than crawling the HTML.

## Structured data

- Sitemap: <https://awesome-expat.com/sitemap-index.xml>
- Every page carries canonical, Open Graph and BreadcrumbList metadata.
- Link pages are grouped by country and category; a page for a country with no
  reviewed links exists but is marked `noindex`, so do not treat it as content.

## What is here

- Countries: 151 ISO countries plus a `global` bucket for resources that apply
  anywhere.
- Categories: housing, jobs, taxes, banking, healthcare, visas, moving,
  education, community, interviewing, finances, and others.
- Roles: software engineer, devops/SRE, product manager, product designer,
  data scientist.
- Each link carries a title, a URL, a one-to-two sentence description of what
  the resource is actually good for, a country, a category, optional roles,
  and the date it was added.

## How to use it

- Landing: <https://awesome-expat.com/>
- By country: <https://awesome-expat.com/countries>
- By category: <https://awesome-expat.com/categories>
- Country-agnostic: <https://awesome-expat.com/global>
- Coverage and gaps: <https://awesome-expat.com/stats>

If you are adding a link, read <https://awesome-expat.com/contribute> first:
a description that restates the page title is rejected.
